name: openbooks
description: Open-source business suite. Run on open books.

paragraphs: Accounting, operations, payroll, and HR for businesses of every size—from solo operators
sending their first invoice to multi-entity corporations with thousands of employees.
Start simple. Turn on new capabilities as you grow. Never outgrow your books.
features: Simple on day one, enterprise-ready when you need it: If you just need customers, invoices, bills, bank reconciliation, and financial statements, that is all you see. As your business grows, flip a switch in Company…

One connected flow from operations to the general ledger: Approved timesheets, warehouse receipts, progress billing applications with retainage, and committed payroll runs flow directly into your job costs, subledgers,…

Books that never drift out of balance: If you have ever chased a mystery discrepancy between your aged receivables report and your balance sheet, or discovered someone edited an invoice in a closed quarter, you know how…

Your server, your data, zero per-seat fees: OpenBooks is open-source (AGPL-3.0-or-later) and self-hosted. Give every employee, field worker, manager, approver, and accountant the access they need without your software…

whatItDoes.text: Accounting, operations, payroll, and HR for businesses of every size—from solo operators

requirements.text: The installer generates credentials, starts PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7, MinIO, the web app, and the background worker, applies migrations, and prints the URL and first administrator login after health checks pass.
Sign in with the printed credentials and follow the company setup wizard: identity, industry, workspace profile, fiscal calendar, chart of accounts, and features.
